summary: Optional advanced connection for a pinned Replicate model version. Protocol-tested; not yet live-qualified in DNAForge. A Replicate account is not required to use Jobs.

staticTools.description: Advanced integration for any Replicate community or private model version. Supply the exact version identifier and that model's input object. Results are preserved without pretending model-specific outputs share one scientific schema. Deterministically qualified; not yet live-qualified in DNAForge.

version.description: Pinned Replicate model version, normally owner/model:version or a version digest.

input.description: The selected model's own input object.

disclosure: This sends your model inputs to Replicate under your own Replicate API token. Replicate bills predictions to that account using the selected model's hardware and run time; DNAForge does not charge for it. The generic integration preserves model-native inputs and outputs and does not claim that an unqualified community model is scientifically validated.
retentionNote: Replicate removes API prediction inputs, outputs, and logs after one hour by default. Import or otherwise save useful output immediately.

cancellation.note: Replicate can cancel predictions that are starting or processing through its Predictions API.
